engine_loop_a.mp3.prompt: Inside a spaceship cockpit: the main thruster engines running under power, a deep heavy rumbling roar with a low turbine whine layered on top, felt through the hull, steady and powerful, seamless loop.

engine_loop_b.mp3.prompt: Spaceship engine thrust heard from the pilot seat: massive low-frequency roar of plasma thrusters, rhythmic subtle pulsing, metal hull resonance and vibration, a soft high turbine whistle, dense and mechanical, seamless loop.

engine_hum_a.mp3.prompt: Spaceship idling, heard in the cockpit: a smooth low reactor drone, faint electrical hum of systems, soft air circulation hiss, calm and steady, very low pitch, seamless loop.

engine_hum_b.mp3.prompt: Idle spaceship engines heard from inside: warm deep reactor hum with a slow subtle throb, quiet mechanical whir of pumps and fans, hull ambience, seamless loop.

engine_start_a.mp3.prompt: Spaceship engines igniting, heard from inside the cockpit: a heavy mechanical clunk of fuel valves, igniter ticking, turbines spooling up with a rising whine, a deep thump as the thrusters catch, building into a powerful steady rumble.

engine_start_b.mp3.prompt: Starting large spacecraft engines heard through the hull: starter motor whirring, rising turbine spool, pressure hiss, a low boom of ignition, then a deep throbbing engine rumble settling to idle.

engine_stop_a.mp3.prompt: Spaceship engines shutting down, heard from the cockpit: the deep rumble cutting off, turbines spooling down with a falling whine, a pressure release hiss, metal ticking as the engines cool.

engine_stop_b.mp3.prompt: Large spacecraft thrusters powering down: falling turbine whine, rumble fading out, a heavy valve clunk, then quiet creaks of cooling metal.

power_up_a.mp3.prompt: Spaceship systems powering on in the cockpit: a heavy main breaker clunk, relays clicking in sequence, a rising electrical hum as power flows through the ship, fans starting, ending in a steady low hum.

power_up_b.mp3.prompt: Cockpit power-up of a large spacecraft: thick mechanical switch throw, cascading relay clacks, capacitors charging with a rising tone, ventilation spinning up, settles to a low electrical drone.

power_down_a.mp3.prompt: Spaceship systems powering off in the cockpit: a heavy breaker clunk, electrical hum falling and dying, fans spinning down, a last relay click, silence.

power_down_b.mp3.prompt: Cockpit power-down of a large spacecraft: switch thrown, descending electrical drone, ventilation winding down, soft relay clacks fading out.

holo_deploy_a.mp3.prompt: Holographic cockpit display projector turning on: a soft servo whir and a quick rising glassy energy shimmer, subtle crackle, settles quietly, short and refined, not a beep.

holo_deploy_b.mp3.prompt: Sci-fi hologram screen materialising from a projector: brief electrical hum swelling with a light airy shimmer and a soft low click at the end, subtle.

holo_retract_a.mp3.prompt: Holographic cockpit display projector turning off: a quick descending glassy shimmer collapsing into a soft low thump, servo whir, subtle and short.

holo_retract_b.mp3.prompt: Sci-fi hologram screen dissolving: falling airy energy sweep and a soft muffled click as the projector shuts, subtle.

holo_tick_a.mp3.prompt: Pressing a button on a holographic cockpit display: a soft, dry, short tactile tick with a faint low electrical body, subtle and quiet, not a beep, not a notification.

holo_tick_b.mp3.prompt: A single quiet sci-fi interface select sound: muted soft click with a tiny low thump, very short, subtle, dry.

switch_click_a.mp3.prompt: A heavy-duty metal toggle switch in a spaceship cockpit flipped: solid mechanical snap and clack, short and dry, close up.

switch_click_b.mp3.prompt: Rugged military aircraft rocker switch pressed: firm plastic and metal click with a slight spring, short, close up.

button_press_a.mp3.prompt: Pressing a backlit physical push button on a spaceship console: a firm, short, muted mechanical click with a soft rubber dampening, close up, no electronic tone.

button_press_b.mp3.prompt: A chunky cockpit console key pressed and released: two soft mechanical clicks, short, close up, no beep.

boost_start_a.mp3.prompt: Spaceship afterburner kicking in, heard from the cockpit: a sudden deep whoosh and a hard thump of extra thrust, the engine roar surging louder.

boost_start_b.mp3.prompt: Sci-fi fighter boost engaging: a punchy low-frequency burst, rushing air and a rising turbine howl, short and powerful.
